errors.evidence: Caption and reference indicate the chart excludes overtime ('изключва извънредния труд'); the machine description says it includes overtime.

The legend labels are reversed in the machine description. In the figure, blue corresponds to 'Мъж' (men) and red to 'Жен' (women), but the machine text uses singular labels and swaps the legend text formatting/interpretation relative to the visible legend.
The description does not clearly state that the figure shows average weekly working hours excluding overtime, as indicated by the human reference and caption.

The reference notes that the countries are ordered alphabetically, but the machine description says only that the order is not marked as alphabetical or sorted by value, omitting the important visual feature that the x-axis follows an alphabetical sequence.
